Tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur LogPose, l: Everything you need to know about LogPose, the daily One Piece game.
LogPose, souvent cherché sous le nom « O: LogPose, often searched as “OnePiecedle”, is a free daily guessing game inspired by Wordle and set in Eiichiro Oda's One Piece universe. Every day, you guess mystery characters across seven game modes.
Choisis un mode, propose un personnage d: Pick a mode, guess a One Piece character, then read the clues revealed with each try: affiliation, origin, bounty, Devil Fruit, Haki… The colors (green, orange) and arrows bring you closer to the day's answer. You only get so many guesses.
Oui, LogPose est 100 % gratuit, sans ins: Yes — LogPose is 100% free, with no sign-up and no download. It plays right in your browser, on mobile and desktop alike.
Combien y a-t-il de personnages et de mo: How many characters and modes are there?
Le jeu compte 258 personnages de One Pie: The game features 258 One Piece characters and seven daily modes: Classic, Wanted, Silhouette, Devil Fruit, Emoji, Opening and Volume. Each mode serves up a new challenge every day.
Y a-t-il un nouveau personnage à deviner: Is there a new character to guess every day?
Oui. Chaque mode propose un nouveau pers: Yes. Each mode has a new mystery character daily, the same for every player. Compare your result with friends and come back each day to keep your streak alive.
Peut-on jouer à OnePiecedle à plusieurs: Can you play OnePiecedle with friends?
Oui, le mode Versus 1v1 permet de défier: Yes — the 1v1 Versus mode lets you challenge a friend in a private room on the same mystery character, in Best-of-1, Best-of-3 or Best-of-5.
Le Log Pose est réglé. À toi de tracer l: The Log Pose is set. Now chart your course.
